nodes.label: The Working Memory Rule: humans hold ≤4 items at once; ≤4 options per decision point
nodes.norm_label: the working memory rule: humans hold ≤4 items at once; ≤4 options per decision point
nodes.rationale: Action buttons: 1 primary, 1–2 secondary, rest in a menu; navigation ≤5 top-level items; docs sidebars ≤4 sibling choices per level; gallery indexes one decision per screen.

nodes.label: Cowan (2001): working memory capacity ≈4 items (revision of Miller's Law)
nodes.norm_label: cowan (2001): working memory capacity ≈4 items (revision of miller's law)

nodes.label: Actionable error: what failed, why (when known and useful), how to recover
nodes.norm_label: actionable error: what failed, why (when known and useful), how to recover
nodes.rationale: Never expose internal codes as the primary message or promise a cause the system cannot know; privacy, payment, deletion and access loss are treated seriously (warmth welcome, jokes not).

nodes.label: Message hierarchy per state: the one fact now, the next action, supporting context, tone
nodes.norm_label: message hierarchy per state: the one fact now, the next action, supporting context, tone
nodes.rationale: Say each idea once; if the heading already explains the state, the intro adds new information or disappears.

nodes.label: Forms: persistent labels (placeholders are examples), requirements before submission, validation without blame
nodes.norm_label: forms: persistent labels (placeholders are examples), requirements before submission, validation without blame

nodes.label: Localization: complete translatable messages, structured variables, room for expansion, accessible names aligned with visible labels
nodes.norm_label: localization: complete translatable messages, structured variables, room for expansion, accessible names aligned with visible labels
nodes.rationale: Do not rely on punctuation, color or iconography alone to carry the message; do not vary words for literary effect in an interface (keep a glossary).

nodes.label: Destructive actions: name object and consequence; prefer undo over confirmation when recovery is safe; no Yes/No/OK/Submit buttons
nodes.norm_label: destructive actions: name object and consequence; prefer undo over confirmation when recovery is safe; no yes/no/ok/submit buttons

nodes.label: Information conveyed by color also needs text, shape, iconography or position
nodes.norm_label: information conveyed by color also needs text, shape, iconography or position
nodes.rationale: For data use distinct lightness, chroma, shape, label or pattern so color is not the only code.

nodes.label: Uniqueness by natural key
nodes.rationale: At most one ProduccionAudiovisual per (id_tmdb, tipo), enforced by the uq_produccion_tmdb_tipo DB constraint. TMDB IDs are not unique across movies and series, so id_tmdb alone MUST NOT be treated as unique. Repeated materialization is idempotent and issues no TMDB request.

nodes.label: design-md-drift finding
nodes.rationale: Counts commits to visual source directories since DESIGN.md was last edited; a commit count is not a contradiction, so never assert DESIGN.md is stale because the number is large.

nodes.label: Schema drift
nodes.rationale: Artifacts written by an older Impeccable: retired fields, missing expected fields, files in retired locations. Mechanical, mostly auto-repairable.

nodes.label: Finding severities (auto / mention / route)
nodes.rationale: Severity says what should happen, not how bad it is: auto is applied with --fix without asking, mention is stated with its fix, route names a command run only if the user asks this turn.

nodes.label: Truth drift
nodes.rationale: The code moved on and the document no longer describes it; no file comparison settles it, so doctor hands document (DESIGN.md) and init (PRODUCT.md) a specific gap rather than a vague suspicion.

nodes.label: Sidecar component translation rules (shadow-DOM snippets)
nodes.rationale: Snippets must be self-contained: expand Tailwind to literal CSS, reference :root custom properties via var(), inline SVG icons, include hover/focus states, skip resets, prefix classes with ds-.

nodes.label: .impeccable/design.json sidecar
nodes.rationale: Carries what Stitch's schema cannot hold (tonal ramps, shadows, motion, breakpoints, full component HTML/CSS for shadow-DOM rendering, narrative); schemaVersion 2 moved token primitives out into the frontmatter and keeps only metadata keyed by token name.

nodes.label: DESIGN.md
nodes.rationale: Durable visual decisions of the project: YAML frontmatter tokens (normative) plus up to eight canonical markdown sections in fixed order; strictly visual, never duplicating PRODUCT.md.

nodes.label: DESIGN.md YAML frontmatter token schema
nodes.rationale: Machine-readable layer: colors, typography, rounded, spacing, components only; token refs use {path.to.token}; component sub-tokens limited to 8 props so shadows, motion and focus rings must live in the sidecar. Tokens are normative, prose contextualizes.

nodes.label: Named Rules ('The [Name] Rule')
nodes.rationale: Short forceful doctrines are memorable, citable and stickier for AI consumers than bullet lists; aim for 1-3 per section.

nodes.label: Document scan mode (auto-extract, then confirm language)
nodes.norm_label: document scan mode (auto-extract, then confirm language)
nodes.rationale: Default when code exists: find CSS custom properties, Tailwind theme, CSS-in-JS themes, token files, component library, global stylesheet and rendered output, then ask the user only for qualitative language that cannot be auto-extracted.

nodes.label: Document seed mode (pre-implementation)
nodes.rationale: For projects with nothing to extract: route through new-work's world workshop and write a directional DESIGN.md seed with placeholders; never fabricate tokens, skip the sidecar, re-run in scan mode once code exists.

nodes.label: Stitch (Google) linter and live panel consumer
nodes.norm_label: stitch (google) linter and live panel consumer

nodes.label: Init completion gate
nodes.rationale: Before new-work or shape/build resumes, PRODUCT.md must exist at the resolved path with the confirmed record; interview notes or planning packets are not substitutes.

nodes.label: impeccable:product-schema marker comment
nodes.rationale: Records which version of the product record the file follows so later versions can tell a deliberately short record from one written before a section existed and never re-run an interview the user already sat through.

nodes.label: Generation precedence (DESIGN.md visual > PRODUCT.md product/voice > surface brief strategy)
nodes.norm_label: generation precedence (design.md visual > product.md product/voice > surface brief strategy)
nodes.rationale: When DESIGN.md is missing, identity is not absent; it is extracted from CSS variables, computed styles and sibling components. Identity preservation is the default.

nodes.label: Impeccable Documenter (inline degraded role)
nodes.rationale: Records the design system after the build; ground truth is the shipped artifact, never the plan. Writing the system after the fact is the point because a rulebook written before the build gets defended against reality instead of describing it.

nodes.label: $impeccable doctor
nodes.rationale: Maintenance, not design: report and repair drift between the project's Impeccable artifacts and what the installed version reads, without opening other files or running side-effect commands.

nodes.label: $impeccable document
nodes.rationale: Generates DESIGN.md so AI agents generating new screens stay on-brand; never silently overwrites an existing DESIGN.md (refresh, overwrite or merge is the user's choice).

nodes.label: Extract Flow
nodes.rationale: Identify reusable patterns, components and tokens, then consolidate them into the design system; design systems grow incrementally.

nodes.label: Init flow ($impeccable init)
nodes.rationale: Captures durable product truth in PRODUCT.md; does not invent a visual world and never writes or offers DESIGN.md, which new-work creates and document records.

nodes.label: Build wins over direction contract
nodes.rationale: Where OWN-WORLD and the built code diverge, the build wins and prose may note the divergence; a value earns its place by the build and by legibility, never by making a finding disappear.

nodes.label: Three-uses reuse threshold
nodes.rationale: Only extract things used 3+ times with the same intent; premature abstraction is worse than duplication, and two buttons that look similar but serve different purposes stay separate.

nodes.label: Entry Atomicity
nodes.rationale: An entry is applied only when every op in it landed; on one op failing, undo that entry's edits and fail it with a concrete reason, so no partial source changes remain for failed or omitted entries.

nodes.label: Repair mode (post-validation source repair)
nodes.rationale: Repair the current source, never the pre-Apply source, with the smallest fix that makes each applied op's newText appear at a hinted, candidate or coupled target; never roll back files yourself.

nodes.label: density live-mode signature param
nodes.rationale: Every layout variant declares a coarse density range param and authors spacing against var(--p-density, 1).

nodes.label: Agent-driven fallback (generated / runtime-injected sources)
nodes.rationale: Wrap refuses non-source files because accepting into one is silent data loss; the agent previews in the served file and, on accept, writes true source (template, stylesheet or data) then removes the temporary wrapper.

nodes.label: Carbonize (permanent rewrite of an accepted variant)
nodes.norm_label: carbonize (permanent rewrite of an accepted variant)
nodes.rationale: The accept stitch-in with markers and inline CSS is temporary; move CSS to the real stylesheet, bake param values, unwrap the variant, delete markers, then impeccable live-complete gates on source_dirty.

nodes.label: Default vs departure mode
nodes.rationale: Default preserves identity (~90% of sessions); departure needs the user's explicit ask in the current request. Unsure means default: a wrong default is recoverable, a wrong departure is not.

nodes.label: Identity lock (Phase A extraction)
nodes.rationale: One sentence of what is actually on screen (real colors, loaded fonts, topology, surface treatment, voice) from DESIGN.md, CSS custom properties, computed styles and siblings; live is variation within identity, and the worst failure is three off-brand variants the user cannot accept.

nodes.label: _instructions field authority
nodes.rationale: Every live tool output may carry _instructions with real ids and paths; when it conflicts with the agent's recollection of live.md, _instructions wins.

nodes.label: Live event types (generate, steer, accept, discard, prefetch, manual_edit_apply, variant_mount_failed, exit)
nodes.norm_label: live event types (generate, steer, accept, discard, prefetch, manual_edit_apply, variant_mount_failed, exit)

nodes.label: impeccable live-wrap scaffold
nodes.rationale: Wraps the picked element for variants; on source-preview targets sourceWritten: false means the agent writes wrapper and variants in ONE edit because a separate scaffold write reloads the framework and strands the browser at 0/N.

nodes.label: Live poll loop (impeccable live-poll)
nodes.rationale: Default long timeout, re-poll immediately after every event or reply; per-harness policy (Claude Code background task, Cursor one-shot background terminal, Codex serviced foreground) because a yielded poll nobody reads is a dead session.

nodes.label: Live session journal (.impeccable/live/sessions/)
nodes.rationale: Append-only canonical durable state that replays unacknowledged work after a helper restart, so the user is never asked to click Go again unless live-resume reports no active session.

nodes.label: Six variation axes (hierarchy, topology, type, color strategy, density, decomposition)
nodes.norm_label: six variation axes (hierarchy, topology, type, color strategy, density, decomposition)
nodes.rationale: Three variants commit to three different primary axes so they read as the same brand at three angles; new fonts, hues or aesthetic-family signals belong to departure mode only.

nodes.label: Live squint test (Phase D drift and family check)
nodes.norm_label: live squint test (phase d drift and family check)
nodes.rationale: Default mode: compare each variant against the identity lock and confirm three different axes. Departure mode: a family pass then a sentence pass; shared labels or rhyming descriptions mean rework.

nodes.label: Svelte component preview mode
nodes.rationale: AST-based scaffold keeps control-flow blocks intact; variants are real single-root components under componentDir, params go in a params.json sidecar, and accept merges mechanically with no cleanup.

nodes.label: Variant parameters (range / steps / toggle knobs)
nodes.rationale: Coarse knobs docked in the browser with zero regeneration cost, driving --p-<id> or data-p-<id>; budget scales with visual weight (0 for leaf, up to 4 for a hero) and a hero with 0 params is almost always a mistake.

nodes.label: Impeccable Manual Edit Applier (inline degraded role)
nodes.norm_label: impeccable manual edit applier (inline degraded role)
nodes.rationale: Applies one leased live manual_edit_apply event to real source; the parent live thread owns polling and protocol replies, the applier owns source edits only.

nodes.label: $impeccable live (interactive variant mode)
nodes.rationale: Select elements in the browser, pick a design action, get three AI-generated variants hot-swapped via HMR; chat is overhead, tokens go to tools and edits.

nodes.label: AI aesthetic calibration self-check
nodes.rationale: AI interfaces cluster around warm cream + serif + terracotta, near-black + neon glow, or broadsheet hairlines + mono labels; if someone could guess the aesthetic from the category alone, rework. A pinned world pins the world, not its softest rendition.

nodes.label: Training-data default font avoidance
nodes.rationale: Fraunces, Playfair, Cormorant, Lora, Space Grotesk, IBM Plex, Inter-as-display, DM Sans and similar mean the search stopped; a subject association (books want a serif) is never a sufficient reason.

nodes.label: 14. Em dashes and en dashes: hard cut in the final rewrite
nodes.community_name: Catalog of 33 AI writing patterns (content, language, style, communication, filler)
nodes.norm_label: 14. em dashes and en dashes: hard cut in the final rewrite
nodes.rationale: One of the most reliable AI tells, so a hard constraint rather than 'use sparingly' (changed in 2.7.0). Replace with period, comma, colon, parentheses or restructure; scan the final for — and – before returning.

nodes.label: Detection guidance: flag clusters of tells, not isolated ones
nodes.community_name: Catalog of 33 AI writing patterns (content, language, style, communication, filler)
nodes.norm_label: detection guidance: flag clusters of tells, not isolated ones
nodes.rationale: Perfect grammar, one em dash, curly quotes or a single 'however' prove nothing; over-editing guts legitimate human prose. A single em dash means nothing; em dashes plus rule-of-three plus 'vibrant tapestry' plus a Conclusion section is a confession.

nodes.label: Process: draft rewrite → 'What makes the below so obviously AI generated?' → final rewrite
nodes.community_name: Catalog of 33 AI writing patterns (content, language, style, communication, filler)
nodes.norm_label: process: draft rewrite → 'what makes the below so obviously ai generated?' → final rewrite
nodes.rationale: A second pass catches lingering AI-isms the first draft misses (added in 2.2.0); the deliverable is draft, still-AI bullets, final rewrite and optional change summary.

nodes.label: Personality and soul: sterile voiceless writing is as obvious as slop
nodes.community_name: Catalog of 33 AI writing patterns (content, language, style, communication, filler)
nodes.norm_label: personality and soul: sterile voiceless writing is as obvious as slop
nodes.rationale: Applies only where voice is wanted (blog, essay, opinion); for encyclopedic, technical, legal or reference text neutral and plain is the correct human voice.

nodes.label: Rewrite, don't delete: same coverage, same paragraph count, preserve meaning
nodes.community_name: Catalog of 33 AI writing patterns (content, language, style, communication, filler)
nodes.norm_label: rewrite, don't delete: same coverage, same paragraph count, preserve meaning
nodes.rationale: Compressing the text drops texture instead of rewriting it; if the original has five paragraphs the rewrite has five.

nodes.label: Secondhand-text guard: never rewrite watched phrases inside quotes, titles, proper names or examples
nodes.community_name: Catalog of 33 AI writing patterns (content, language, style, communication, filler)
nodes.norm_label: secondhand-text guard: never rewrite watched phrases inside quotes, titles, proper names or examples
nodes.rationale: A phrase being discussed is not a phrase being used (false-positive guard added in 2.8.1).

nodes.label: WCAG AA minimums: body text 4.5:1, large text 3:1, controls/icons/focus indicators 3:1
nodes.norm_label: wcag aa minimums: body text 4.5:1, large text 3:1, controls/icons/focus indicators 3:1
nodes.rationale: Verify computed pairs, interactive states, overlays, text on images, disabled content and both themes; simulate vision deficiencies; prefer explicit colors over translucent overlay chains when alpha makes contrast context-dependent.

nodes.label: Craft-floor Verify checklist: contrast, depth, spacing, type, motion, states, browser surfaces, copy, coverage
nodes.norm_label: craft-floor verify checklist: contrast, depth, spacing, type, motion, states, browser surfaces, copy, coverage
nodes.rationale: Checks on the built result, run together in the batched inspection rounds because they share one render: contrast ≥4.5:1 / ≥3:1 with secondary text tinted from the surface hue; shadows with offset and soft blur; body measure 65–75ch, display max 6rem, tracking floor -0.04em; hover/disabled/loading/error/empty states.

nodes.label: craft-floor.md
nodes.rationale: Loaded after direction is settled, immediately before any UI edit; it holds the quality floor, the absolute bans and the reflexes no detector catches. A pinned brief or the committed visual world overrides anything here; the agent's habit does not. It never picks the direction.

nodes.label: On colored surfaces derive secondary text from the foreground or surface hue, never washed-out generic gray
nodes.norm_label: on colored surfaces derive secondary text from the foreground or surface hue, never washed-out generic gray

nodes.label: Browser surfaces carry the design: theme text selection, caret, scrollbars, focus rings, underline offset, tabular numerals
nodes.norm_label: browser surfaces carry the design: theme text selection, caret, scrollbars, focus rings, underline offset, tabular numerals
nodes.rationale: These ship with browser defaults that belong to no design system; theming them from the palette is the cheapest signal that a page was built rather than assembled, and the one models skip most reliably.

nodes.label: Declare elevation once (border or shadow); card radii 12–16px; tracking -0.02 to -0.03em reads better than the -0.04em floor
nodes.norm_label: declare elevation once (border or shadow); card radii 12–16px; tracking -0.02 to -0.03em reads better than the -0.04em floor
nodes.rationale: A 1px border under a wide soft shadow is the ghost card; pills are for small controls.

nodes.label: Kicker/eyebrow label above a heading: a hard ban no brief earns back
nodes.norm_label: kicker/eyebrow label above a heading: a hard ban no brief earns back
nodes.rationale: The heading carries its own weight; delete the label and let the heading speak.

nodes.label: Real illustration or none: sketch-style SVG scenes, doodle classes and feTurbulence grain read as amateur
nodes.norm_label: real illustration or none: sketch-style svg scenes, doodle classes and feturbulence grain read as amateur
nodes.rationale: Bans SVG imitating pictures, never SVG doing geometry: crisp vector shapes, diagrams, animated linework and shader effects remain first-class. Geometry means shapes a session can specify exactly.

nodes.label: Refuse list: the category's defaults (same-size icon cards, hero-metric template, section numbers, gradient text, decorative glass, colored border-left, hard offset shadows, monospace costume, emoji icons, geometric masks...)
nodes.norm_label: refuse list: the category's defaults (same-size icon cards, hero-metric template, section numbers, gradient text, decorative glass, colored border-left, hard offset shadows, monospace costume, emoji icons, geometric masks...)
nodes.rationale: Defaults, not bans: the brief's own words can earn any of them; reaching for one when the axis is free means you were not deciding, and recognizing that means rewriting the element, not softening it. Light or dark is picked from the use scene, not the category.

nodes.label: A system display face (Impact, Arial Black, platform sans) as display voice of an own-world page is a failure, not a fallback
nodes.norm_label: a system display face (impact, arial black, platform sans) as display voice of an own-world page is a failure, not a fallback
nodes.rationale: Source and self-host a face whose character matches the approved lettering.

nodes.label: Verify in bounded passes, not a loop
nodes.norm_label: verify in bounded passes, not a loop
nodes.rationale: Open-ended self-QA burns the user's money doing worse what the finish handoffs do better: build fully, inspect once with a batched round (desktop+mobile on web; shipped device classes on native), fix everything in one batch, confirm with at most one more round, stop polishing.

nodes.label: Implementation Integrity verdict (start here): coherent product-specific system vs. repeated shortcuts and design-system drift
nodes.norm_label: implementation integrity verdict (start here): coherent product-specific system vs. repeated shortcuts and design-system drift
nodes.rationale: Run the bundled detector and verify each finding in context; keep deterministic findings separate from visual judgment and call out false positives.

nodes.norm_label: heuristic 3: user control and freedom (undo, cancel, escape)

nodes.norm_label: allowed recommendation commands (adapt, animate, audit, bolder, clarify, colorize, critique, delight, distill, document, harden, layout, onboard, optimize, overdrive, polish, quieter, shape, typeset); end with polish

nodes.label: Assessment A: unanchored design review (design specificity, holistic design, cognitive load, emotional journey, Nielsen heuristics 0–4)
nodes.norm_label: assessment a: unanchored design review (design specificity, holistic design, cognitive load, emotional journey, nielsen heuristics 0–4)

nodes.label: Assessment B: `impeccable detect --json` CLI scan + browser overlay via `impeccable live-server` and detect.js
nodes.norm_label: assessment b: `impeccable detect --json` cli scan + browser overlay via `impeccable live-server` and detect.js
nodes.rationale: Exit 0 clean / 2 findings; URLs skip CLI scan; preflight mutable injection (set document.title, append a script) before claiming a [Human] overlay exists; the live server runs in background with a recorded stop method and is stopped before reporting.

nodes.label: Cognitive Load Assessment: intrinsic / extraneous / germane load, 8-item checklist, 8 common violations
nodes.norm_label: cognitive load assessment: intrinsic / extraneous / germane load, 8-item checklist, 8 common violations
nodes.rationale: Eliminate extraneous load ruthlessly; 0–1 checklist failures = low, 2–3 moderate, 4+ critical.

nodes.label: Design Specificity verdict (start here): authored for this product or category-interchangeable?
nodes.norm_label: design specificity verdict (start here): authored for this product or category-interchangeable?
nodes.rationale: Combines the unanchored LLM assessment, the deterministic scan (counts, locations, false positives) and the visual overlays if injection succeeded.

nodes.label: .impeccable/critique/ignore.md: the only prior-run input critique consumes (matching findings dropped silently)
nodes.norm_label: .impeccable/critique/ignore.md: the only prior-run input critique consumes (matching findings dropped silently)

nodes.label: Issue severity P0 Blocking / P1 Major / P2 Minor / P3 Polish
nodes.norm_label: issue severity p0 blocking / p1 major / p2 minor / p3 polish
nodes.rationale: If unsure between two levels ask 'would a user contact support about this?'; if yes it is at least P1. Shared verbatim by audit.md and audit.native.md.

nodes.label: Nielsen's 10 usability heuristics scored 0–4 (/40) with rating bands
nodes.norm_label: nielsen's 10 usability heuristics scored 0–4 (/40) with rating bands
nodes.rationale: A 4 means genuinely excellent; most real interfaces score 20–32. Heuristics 7 (Flexibility) and 10 (Help) may be n/a on Persuade and Experience surfaces; renormalize the total to the applicable maximum (e.g. 24/32) and never print /40 over a partial set.

nodes.label: Persist the snapshot to .impeccable/critique/ via `impeccable critique-storage write` with IMPECCABLE_CRITIQUE_META; read trend of last 5 runs
nodes.norm_label: persist the snapshot to .impeccable/critique/ via `impeccable critique-storage write` with impeccable_critique_meta; read trend of last 5 runs
nodes.rationale: So the user can refer back and $impeccable polish can pick up priority issues without copy-paste; the helper records a content fingerprint so polish distinguishes the assessed bytes from later edits; max_score is stored so renormalized totals compare honestly. Skipped when the target slug is null.

nodes.label: critique.md
nodes.rationale: Resolve one stable target, run two independent assessments, synthesize a design critique, persist a snapshot, and ask the user what to improve next; the chat response is the primary deliverable, the snapshot is an archive.

nodes.label: Ask the User / final-question gate: 2–4 targeted questions with concrete options, last in the same message, or a literal `Questions skipped: <reason>` line
nodes.norm_label: ask the user / final-question gate: 2–4 targeted questions with concrete options, last in the same message, or a literal `questions skipped: <reason>` line
nodes.rationale: Prose emitted after a structured question is withheld until the user answers, so the report goes first and the question last; skipping is allowed only with fewer than 3 Priority Issues. Ending with neither is the most common way this command fails.

nodes.label: Degraded banner: report's first line must be `⚠️ DEGRADED: single-context (<reason>)` when run inline
nodes.norm_label: degraded banner: report's first line must be `⚠️ degraded: single-context (<reason>)` when run inline
nodes.rationale: A silent degraded critique is a failed critique; skipping sub-agents without the banner is the most common failure of this command. Dual-agent runs declare `Method: dual-agent (A: <id> · B: <id>)`.

nodes.label: Deliver the report in chat before any persistence work
nodes.norm_label: deliver the report in chat before any persistence work
nodes.rationale: The most common failure is composing the report once, straight into the persistence heredoc: a perfect archive nobody has read. If the report exists only in .impeccable/critique/, the run produced nothing.

nodes.label: Hard invariant: Assessment A and B run as two isolated sub-agents; inline only when no sub-agent tool exists
nodes.norm_label: hard invariant: assessment a and b run as two isolated sub-agents; inline only when no sub-agent tool exists
nodes.rationale: Detector output is deterministic but still anchors judgment, so Assessment A must finish before detector findings enter the synthesis context; they must not see each other's output. On Codex the agent asks once for permission (asking is the normal path, not a degradation).

nodes.label: Commands table (Build / Evaluate / Refine / Enhance / Fix / Iterate)
nodes.norm_label: commands table (build / evaluate / refine / enhance / fix / iterate)

nodes.label: openai.yaml (Codex agent interface: display_name, short_description, default_prompt)
nodes.norm_label: openai.yaml (codex agent interface: display_name, short_description, default_prompt)

nodes.label: Polish (impeccable reference)
nodes.rationale: Polish is refinement, never concealed redesign: preserve the incumbent visual world, content and behavior; if the concept itself is wrong, recommend redesign or `bolder` instead of smuggling in a replacement.

nodes.label: Quieter (impeccable reference)
nodes.rationale: Quiet design is harder than bold design because subtlety needs precision; reduce intensity without losing personality or collapsing to generic.

nodes.label: Routing / command guidance (impeccable reference)
nodes.rationale: Bare `$impeccable` invocations get a context-aware menu built from signals instead of a static list; recommendations are suggestions the user confirms, never auto-run.

nodes.label: Shape (impeccable reference)
nodes.rationale: Discover what should be made and how it should work, then return a confirmed design brief without code; shape never writes code or a direction contract.

nodes.label: Typeset (impeccable reference)
nodes.rationale: Typography carries information, hierarchy and voice; improve it inside the established visual world and only replace identity via new-work.

nodes.label: Audit documents issues; it doesn't fix them (routes to other commands)
nodes.norm_label: audit documents issues; it doesn't fix them (routes to other commands)
nodes.rationale: A code-level audit, not a design critique: check what's measurable and verifiable; every finding maps to a command and the list ends with $impeccable polish.

nodes.label: Amplify what the system already owns; more effects is the opposite of bold
nodes.norm_label: amplify what the system already owns; more effects is the opposite of bold
nodes.rationale: A section reads flat because it quietly opts out of the system's strongest moves its neighbors already use (display type at full strength, structural devices, signature motif, pacing). Commit to one decisive move, then quiet everything around it; if every element got louder, the section got flatter.

nodes.label: 'Bolder' during an open direction round means the Bolder hand-register steer (new-work), not this command
nodes.norm_label: 'bolder' during an open direction round means the bolder hand-register steer (new-work), not this command
nodes.rationale: This command refines a surface whose world already shipped; a direction decision on the table owns the word first.

nodes.label: Scope is sovereign: touch only the named target; no new colors, fonts, radii, shadows or primitives
nodes.norm_label: scope is sovereign: touch only the named target; no new colors, fonts, radii, shadows or primitives
nodes.rationale: 'Everything else stays' is a literal instruction. If the existing system cannot express the direction, stop and ask, naming the exact addition and the job it would do, rather than expanding the system unilaterally.

nodes.label: The skeleton test: strip the copy and see if hierarchy alone still says what the section is
nodes.norm_label: the skeleton test: strip the copy and see if hierarchy alone still says what the section is
nodes.rationale: If it only works once the words return, the boldness is in the text size, not the design. An image placeholder names a job, an anchor and evidence, not a cue for a decorative photo.

nodes.label: `craft` is a deprecated alias for an ordinary new-work request
nodes.norm_label: `craft` is a deprecated alias for an ordinary new-work request
nodes.rationale: It adds no setup, interview, checkpoint, tool or quality behavior; natural requests ('build this feature', 'redesign this screen') use the same flow, so never tell users they need to invoke craft. Missing PRODUCT.md routes through init, then new-work.

nodes.label: Core rule: production cleanup, not new art direction
nodes.norm_label: core rule: production cleanup, not new art direction
nodes.rationale: Preserve the reference's visual role, silhouette, palette, lighting, material, texture, camera angle and composition; keep perspective only when it belongs to the object; remove presentation chrome (card transform, shadow, rounded clipping, border) that CSS should draw.

nodes.label: Polish is refinement, not concealed redesign
nodes.norm_label: polish is refinement, not concealed redesign
nodes.rationale: Keeps scope honest: a polish pass must not silently replace the design; when the concept is wrong it says so and routes to redesign/bolder.

nodes.label: Quiet is not generic (luxury, not laziness)
nodes.norm_label: quiet is not generic (luxury, not laziness)
nodes.rationale: Quiet without intent collapses to generic; hierarchy, color and personality must survive the cuts.

nodes.label: Never repair drift as a side effect of a design task (CONTEXT_STALE)
nodes.norm_label: never repair drift as a side effect of a design task (context_stale)
nodes.rationale: A CONTEXT_STALE finding is reported, not acted on, unless the user asks; the one exception is a finding marked `auto`, which the next write to that file performs anyway.

nodes.label: Refinement preserves; redesign replaces
nodes.rationale: Refinement keeps incumbent identity, behavior, copy and everything out of scope. Redesign keeps product truth, content, function and constraints but treats the old look as anti-reference and replaces DESIGN.md. Never split the difference into polish on the discarded look.

nodes.label: The brief wins
nodes.rationale: Honor pinned aesthetics, eras, materials, fonts and palettes even when they conflict with a saturated-pattern warning; redirecting a clear brief toward the agent's taste is failure.

nodes.rationale: Mobile web remains web and a native wrapper around a website does not make its design language native; a recorded native platform loads ios.md/android.md before any design work.

nodes.label: HIG conformance (system navigation, safe area, modality)
nodes.norm_label: hig conformance (system navigation, safe area, modality)

nodes.label: iOS slop test
nodes.rationale: Would a fluent iPhone user trust this app or pause at off-spec controls? The tell is 'ported from a website': reinvented nav bars, custom back gestures, web-shaped buttons, hover-dependent affordances.

nodes.label: Simulator screenshots via xcrun simctl
nodes.rationale: Screenshots come from the Simulator, never a browser; capture every shipped device class plus Dark Mode and a large Dynamic Type size, and say whether hardware or simulator produced the evidence.

nodes.label: Squint test (reading order)
nodes.rationale: With detail blurred, the primary element, secondary element and major groups should still be identifiable in order.

nodes.label: Color strategy (Restrained / Committed / Full palette / Drenched)
nodes.norm_label: color strategy (restrained / committed / full palette / drenched)
nodes.rationale: Pick a strategy before picking colors; color commits at page scale; dark or light is never a default but forced by one sentence of physical scene.

nodes.label: Visitor mode (Persuade / Operate / Read / Experience)
nodes.rationale: Persuade must make the offer intelligible with a visible action; Operate may never obscure task or affordance; Read keeps comprehension and wayfinding; Experience lets the work lead from the first viewport.

nodes.label: Product slop test (earned familiarity)
nodes.rationale: Product UI's failure mode is not flatness but strangeness without purpose: over-decorated buttons, mismatched controls, display fonts in labels, invented affordances; the bar is whether a category-fluent user trusts it immediately.

nodes.label: iOS platform reference
nodes.rationale: On native, HIG conformance governs structure, navigation and interaction in every visitor mode; brand expresses only through the layer the platform leaves open (tint, type, motion, content).

nodes.label: $impeccable layout
nodes.rationale: Layout turns product priority into reading order, grouping, rhythm and usable space; diagnose the structural problem before moving boxes.

nodes.label: Operate mode depth (and Read notes)
nodes.rationale: When design serves the product (app UIs, dashboards, tools): the tool should disappear into the task; consistency over surprise, delight saved for moments.

nodes.label: SKILL.md (impeccable skill entry: modes and design rules)
nodes.norm_label: skill.md (impeccable skill entry: modes and design rules)

nodes.label: watchdog[watchmedo] (auto-reload del worker Celery)
nodes.rationale: Celery no recarga código solo, a diferencia del runserver de Django; el extra [watchmedo] aporta el comando que usa el servicio celery-worker del docker-compose.

nodes.label: Autenticación JWT (access + refresh, sesión 8 h) + bcrypt
nodes.norm_label: autenticacion jwt (access + refresh, sesion 8 h) + bcrypt

nodes.label: manage.py send_test_email (+ RESEND_TEST_RECIPIENT)
nodes.rationale: Verifica el backend de email configurado; en desarrollo RESEND_TEST_RECIPIENT redirige al destinatario de prueba.

nodes.label: Error Mapping
nodes.rationale: MUST raise a domain exception on HTTP errors or transport failures, all inheriting from TMDBError: 429 -> TMDBRateLimited, 404 -> TMDBNotFound, other 4xx -> TMDBBadRequest, 5xx -> TMDBServerError, network/transport -> TMDBTransportError.

nodes.label: Error mapping
nodes.rationale: MUST map TMDBError subclasses to HTTP statuses via a DRF exception handler: TMDBNotFound 404, TMDBBadRequest 400, TMDBRateLimited 429, TMDBServerError and TMDBTransportError 502 or 503 (exact split resolved in design).

nodes.label: Embedding enqueue
nodes.rationale: After persisting, MUST ensure a ProduccionEmbedding exists in pending and enqueue generar_embedding(produccion_id) without waiting. Enqueue only when the embedding row is newly created: re-enqueuing on every visit would fill the queue with duplicated work; refreshing failed/stale embeddings belongs to the C-04b backfill. The enqueue MUST be deferred to transaction.on_commit() because the worker runs in another process with its own connection and a message sent before commit would point at a row it cannot see; with no open transaction the callback runs immediately, and a rollback enqueues nothing.

nodes.label: Canonical text and source hash
nodes.rationale: Embedded text is built from a fixed ordered set of labelled sections: Title, Genres, Directors, Cast, Keywords, Synopsis. Labels are English and stable because the TMDB corpus is English and the target model was trained on such text; changing a label changes every hash. Array fields MUST be normalized (trimmed, empties dropped, sorted) because TMDB does not guarantee stable order; otherwise identical content would hash differently and embeddings would regenerate forever. SHA-256 of the text is stored as source_hash and the producing model as model_version, since vectors from different models are not comparable.

nodes.label: Database-level invariants
nodes.rationale: Enforced in the schema, not only in Python: at most one embedding per production (OneToOneField => UNIQUE); estado='ready' only with non-null vector via the ck_embedding_ready_requiere_vector check constraint; deleting a production cascades to its embedding. A ready row without a vector would count as done while invisible to search, so no write path may produce one.

nodes.label: Embedding lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Lifecycle MUST be pending -> processing -> ready | failed. Semantic search considers only ready rows; every other state is invisible to the end user. A production MUST remain visible in the catalog regardless of embedding state, so the embedding lives in its own table, never as columns of ProduccionAudiovisual.

nodes.label: Provider extension point
nodes.rationale: Provider access is isolated in catalogo.services.embeddings.generar_vector(texto). Until B-06 lands it MUST fail explicitly with NotImplementedError rather than return a placeholder vector, so no meaningless data is stored. Replacing that function MUST be sufficient to enable real embeddings: lifecycle, claiming, hashing, enqueueing and failure handling already exist and MUST NOT change. With the stub, every embedding ends in failed with a null vector.

nodes.label: Modelo de datos (ER: Usuario, ProduccionAudiovisual, Calificacion, Resena, Lista/Tiene, Chat, Mensaje, ProduccionEmbedding)
nodes.norm_label: modelo de datos (er: usuario, produccionaudiovisual, calificacion, resena, lista/tiene, chat, mensaje, produccionembedding)
nodes.rationale: Producción unificada para películas y series diferenciadas por `tipo`; Calificación única por (usuario, producción); Reseña 1:1 con Calificación; Chat con contexto JSONB.

nodes.label: Output contract: one line per region `<id> <plate path> <WxH> <score%|unscored> <accepted|needs_parent_review|blocked> <note>` plus blockers and assumptions
nodes.norm_label: output contract: one line per region `<id> <plate path> <wxh> <score%|unscored> <accepted|needs_parent_review|blocked> <note>` plus blockers and assumptions
nodes.rationale: Nothing else: no summary, praise or implementation advice; the parent runs `impeccable build-phase advance` and a visual acceptance never overrides a failing gate.

nodes.label: Plate: a raster region regenerated at ≥1.5x the comp region size from the comp crop, with UI text and page chrome removed
nodes.norm_label: plate: a raster region regenerated at ≥1.5x the comp region size from the comp crop, with ui text and page chrome removed
nodes.rationale: Comp crops are references, never shipping pixels: a comp is reference grade and a shipped crop is how a beautiful comp becomes a blurry site. The page draws text, controls, radius, shadow and layout in code; the plate carries what code cannot draw.

nodes.label: Setup: run `impeccable context` once per session, then load the playbook, then craft-floor before any UI edit
nodes.norm_label: setup: run `impeccable context` once per session, then load the playbook, then craft-floor before any ui edit
nodes.rationale: The launcher is a self-contained binary (no Node needed); if it fails, announce 'Context loading did not run' before the next tool call and read PRODUCT.md/DESIGN.md directly without inventing context.

nodes.label: PRODUCT.md / DESIGN.md project context artifacts (+ surface briefs)
nodes.norm_label: product.md / design.md project context artifacts (+ surface briefs)
nodes.rationale: Loaded by `impeccable context`; missing DESIGN.md alone does not make a project greenfield: new-work decides whether to preserve, expand or replace the incumbent world.

nodes.label: asset-producer.md
nodes.rationale: Generated from skill/agents/ at build time for harnesses with no subagent capability: the parent runs this role inline, steps fully out of the work just finished, adopts only this file's instructions, produces the full output contract first and acts on it itself, disclosing the substitution in one line.

nodes.label: When the design hook is active it enforces the mechanical checks as you edit; act on its findings instead of re-auditing
nodes.norm_label: when the design hook is active it enforces the mechanical checks as you edit; act on its findings instead of re-auditing

nodes.label: Decision comp: one decision card → one north-star comp file at the card's declared `comp` path
nodes.norm_label: decision comp: one decision card → one north-star comp file at the card's declared `comp` path
nodes.rationale: Generate first, plan never: the file on disk is the deliverable and the decision page waits on it. Prompt led by the surface's own structure, fully committed in the card's palette/type/material; every sibling renders at equal fidelity so the comparison stays honest; real product name and content only, never invented claims, prices or dates.

nodes.label: Measured spec `.impeccable/build/spec.json` (from `impeccable comp-spec`) is the inventory
nodes.norm_label: measured spec `.impeccable/build/spec.json` (from `impeccable comp-spec`) is the inventory
nodes.rationale: If there is no spec, stop and ask the parent to run comp-spec; the agent never inventories the comp itself because a second inventory disagrees with the first. Regions carry id, kind (plate/image/texture), pixel box, sampled palette, aspect, note and plate path.

nodes.label: Background decision: isolated figure/object/line drawing → transparent PNG cutout with native alpha; photo/full-frame/texture → opaque
nodes.norm_label: background decision: isolated figure/object/line drawing → transparent png cutout with native alpha; photo/full-frame/texture → opaque
nodes.rationale: Never chroma-key or flatten native transparent output; verify composites on light and dark grounds (white paint solid, interior holes clear, no halos); a painted checkerboard means retry with the API fallback.

nodes.label: Two misses on one region: keep the better plate, mark `needs_parent_review`, name the drift
nodes.norm_label: two misses on one region: keep the better plate, mark `needs_parent_review`, name the drift
nodes.rationale: On a visual miss tighten the prompt and regenerate once; report `unscored` until the parent's plates gate scores it.
